points.description: States that every dimension except the first must be specified when passing a multi-dimensional array to a function; equivalent wording such as 'all dimensions after the first', 'the remaining dimensions', or 'only the first dimension may be omitted' earns full marks.
points.partial_credit: Half marks for saying all dimensions must be specified without the exception for the first, or for saying only that the first dimension may be omitted without stating that all remaining dimensions must be specified.

levels.says: Says all dimensions must be specified, omitting that the first dimension may be left out; or says only that the first dimension may be omitted without making clear that all other dimensions must be specified.
Mentions that dimensions must be specified but does not identify which dimensions, or gives a vague/ambiguous statement about the first dimension.

rubric.notes: Full marks require the answer to say that all dimensions except the first must be specified. Part marks are given for an answer that says all dimensions must be specified, or that only the first may be omitted, without the complete contrast. An answer saying only the first dimension must be specified, or giving no relevant statement, earns no marks.
